secrets.name: OPENSUBTITLES_API_KEY
secrets.description: OpenSubtitles API key (https://www.opensubtitles.com/consumers/api). Optional — only needed for the subtitle search/proxy feature; the app boots without it.

secrets.name: OPENSUBTITLES_USERNAME
secrets.description: OpenSubtitles account username. Optional — only for the subtitles feature.

secrets.name: OPENSUBTITLES_PASSWORD
secrets.description: OpenSubtitles account password. Optional — only for the subtitles feature.
